title: Texas expense trip likely maps to the USC4AM Flex event
summary: Official sources confirm a Texas Flex event in the relevant period, but do not independently establish Austin or the county travelers' attendance.

data.claim: The reported Austin conference trip is strongly consistent with USC4AM's November 13–14, 2023 Flex-hosted Texas event, but the official Center page does not identify Austin or publish an attendee list.
data.adjudication: Do not promote to confirmed attendance without travel dates or attendee records.
